title: Lab - Kernel runtime parameters and SELinux/AppArmor
description: Tune a parameter and fix an SELinux denial.
scenario: Tune a parameter and fix an SELinux denial. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - sysctl
tasks.instructions: Enable IPv4 forwarding now and persistently.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Context
tasks.instructions: Move a file into /var/www/html and make its SELinux context match the directory.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Port
tasks.instructions: Allow httpd to listen on port 8080 under SELinux.
